556	### Proxy helpers
557	
558	> Portable loopback-proxy helpers. Honors `$LOCAL_PROXY_URL` (+ optional `$LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL` for split Clash `socks-port:` configs); otherwise prefers an active Clash config (`mixed-port:` or `port:`/`socks-port:` from `~/.config/clash/config.yaml` or `~/Library/Application Support/clash/config.yaml`) before falling back to probing ports 7890/7891/1087/8118/8080 with `nc -z -w1`. Detection is cached per shell; `proxy-off` and `proxy-refresh` clear that cache before the next lookup. Set `$LOCAL_PROXY_AUTO_ACTIVATE=1` to auto-export env vars on shell startup. Full guide: [docs/tools/web-reader.md](../tools/web-reader.md). See also: [docs/tools/containers.md](../tools/containers.md) for how `$LOCAL_PROXY_URL` feeds the chezmoi-managed `~/.docker/config.json` `proxies.default` block.
559	
560	| Command | Type | Source File | Description |
561	|---------|------|-------------|-------------|
562	| `withproxy` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Run a single command with proxy env vars exported to the child only (e.g. `withproxy curl ...`) |
563	| `try_direct_then_proxy` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Run a command direct; on failure, retry via `withproxy`. Used as the default for reader functions. |
564	| `proxy-on` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Export `http_proxy`/`https_proxy`/`HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY` in the current shell |
565	| `proxy-off` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Unset all proxy env vars in the current shell |
566	| `proxy-status` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Report state: **active** (exported), **available** (detected), or **unavailable** |
567	| `proxy-test` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Test detected proxy egress with `curl https://www.google.com/generate_204` (HTTP, not ICMP ping) |
568	| `proxy-refresh` | function | `dot_config/shell/50_networking.sh` | Clear cached detection, re-probe, print status (use after toggling your proxy) |

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-8 2026-06-22 06:31:20Z)**_

All done. Here's what I changed and verified.

## What changed

**`dot_config/shell/96_ssh_setup.sh`** — the "Step 3: Local SSH config" stage of `ssh-setup-remote` no longer blindly appends. It now auto-detects two situations:

- **Existing host** (e.g. `ssh-setup-remote ts_mac`, where `ts_mac` already resolves): it finds the `Host` block — **recursively following `Include` directives** into `~/.ssh/config.d/*` — and **adds the `IdentityFile` into that block, in the file it actually lives in**, instead of creating a duplicate stanza. Indentation (tab vs spaces) is matched, the key is written `~/`-relative, and re-running with the same key is a no-op. If the block already has an `IdentityFile`, it asks `[r]eplace / [a]dd another / [s]kip`, and offers `IdentitiesOnly yes` if missing.
- **New adhoc host** (`user@ip`): the original append flow, plus — when it writes a `config.d/` drop-in but your `~/.ssh/config` has no `Include` line (the exact state on this machine right now) — it offers to add `Include ~/.ssh/config.d/*` so the entry actually loads.

The find/edit logic is a single inline `python3` helper `_ssh_cfg_py` (recursion, glob, indentation, atomic 0600 write). If `python3` is absent it returns 127 and the wizard falls back to the old append-only behavior.

**Docs (cross-file mirrors per CLAUDE.md):** updated the wizard's Step 5 description in `docs/tutorials/setup_ssh_key_on_remote.md` + `.zh-TW.md` and fixed the stale source path (`~/.config/zsh/tools/96_ssh_setup.zsh` → `~/.config/shell/96_ssh_setup.sh`); added the missing `ssh-setup-remote` row to `docs/shells/aliases.md` + `.zh-TW.md`.

## Verification (nothing real was touched — all in temp dirs / redirected `$HOME`)

- `bash -n` / `zsh -n` and source-check pass in **both** shells.
- `find` resolves a Host across an `Include`'d drop-in; `insert` (insert/replace/add) edits in place preserving tab indent and tildifying the key; idempotent re-run; wildcard `Host *` patterns correctly *don't* match as an exact alias; `ensure-include`/`add-include` are idempotent.
- Full interactive **Mode B** run: added the key in place, **exactly one** `Host` block, `ssh -G` validates.
- Full interactive **Mode A** run: appended to a `config.d/` drop-in and auto-wired the missing `Include`; `ssh -G -F` resolves through it.
- `python3`-missing path returns 127 (fallback).
- `mkdocs build --strict`: my edited files produce **zero** warnings; the 11 strict warnings are all the pre-existing zh-TW anchor-drift tracked in `backlog/mkdocs-anchor-drift.md`.
- Real `~/.ssh/config` confirmed untouched.

To put it live: `chezmoi apply` (or your `cas` wrapper) deploys the updated `96_ssh_setup.sh` to `~/.config/shell/`, then re-source your shell.

One thing I left intentionally unchanged: the **new-host append** path still writes the IdentityFile as the absolute key path (its original behavior); only the new in-place edit path tildifies. Say the word if you'd like the append path tildified too for consistency.
